scope: Existing predictions only. No trained model, generated label, MD, QM, TDDFT or optimizer step.
sample_convention: Figs. 5-8 each have 900 training and 100 test vector rows. Pooled 2700/300 counts scalar components, not independent molecular conformations.

metric_definitions.normalized_vector_error: sqrt(mean(||predicted-calculated||^2))/sqrt(mean(||calculated||^2)); invariant to a common rigid rotation and common unit rescaling
metric_definitions.angles: Signed vector directions, arccos clipped dot product, degrees; require both norms above threshold
metric_definitions.auxiliary_axis_angle: min(theta,180-theta), an explicitly phase-insensitive orientation diagnostic only; no source vector signs or coupling calculations are changed
metric_definitions.undefined: None in JSON or blank CSV, never replaced with zero

norm_threshold_choice.meaning: Absolute numerical stability cutoff, not an inferred author preprocessing step or physically calibrated scale

residual.quartile_rule: Within each target/split: calculated-norm empirical quartiles; ties assigned to the upper bin; last upper bound inclusive.
residual.largest_error_scope: Three locators and derived error norms only; no source vectors or molecule/conformation identity is implied.

rank_scope: Fig. 9 validation-row ranking, not the 180 photocatalytic-system ranking. First 900/final 100 inherit conditional algebraic alignment; Fig. 9 itself does not explicitly label a split.
rank_ties: Spearman uses ascending average exact-tie ranks; Kendall is tau-b. Top/bottom-k select exactly k with a stable original-row tie break. Counts and denominators are retained; k=n is trivial.
array_storage: In-memory source arrays only. Tracked outputs are 32 scalar rows, 24 vector summaries, 6 coupling-rank summaries and compact matrices/quartiles/error-only locators.
